name: Risky Way
author: Addicting Games
description: Risky Way is a free instant game. The highways of the future are risky and if you want to survive you'll need to be smarter than all of them combined. All you have to do in this nerve-tingling racing game is click, hold, and let go. Of course, if you want to be an effective driver who is able to survive you'll have to know when to click, how long to hold, and only let go at the appropriate time. This is a simple mechanism but as the roads become more dangerous and difficult to navigate, it will become trickier and trickier to hold on. This is an endless style game where the levels don't end: you do. You're here to stay alive longer than any other player and climb your way to the top of the leaderboard using your reflexes and a little luck. Do you think you have what it takes to overcome the obstacles, slalom through the tightest corners, and hold on long enough to become the leader of the pack? Will you rise above and prove that you have what it takes to put the pedal to the metal and swish across the finish line like a boss? Well, here is your chance to prove it.
